input.summary: City of Ashby Creek, MO RFP 2027-014 (with Addendum No. 1): 5 park buildings from Table C-1 (PB-1 to PB-4 in scope, 19,820 GSF after the Addendum revised PB-3 to 2,420 SF; PB-5 closed/scheduled for demolition, not included). Grounds: 26 sites from Table A-1 registered as mowable turf (Svc Lvl 1 improved / Svc Lvl 2 semi-improved), rough mow (Svc Lvl 3), ballfields, planting beds and tree counts. Site 14 deleted by Addendum; Site 9 turf revised to 7.15 ac. 11 median/ROW segments from Table A-2 registered as sq ft computed from Length × Width × Sides (note 1/), with M-6 revised to 3,180 LF and M-5 as paved (not mowed). 4 open-air picnic shelter/gazebo slabs (Table C-2) registered as hardscape. Previous award: Halvorsen Turf Management, LLC, PR-2022-031, $612,480 CY2025 annual cost (mowing only).
unresolved: C-1: 6 registered rows vs 5 declared because PB-3 was registered twice: once from Table C-1 (2,240 GSF) and once from Addendum No. 1 item d (revised to 2,420 GSF, cleanable 2,130, fixtures 9/3/7/0). It is one building; the Addendum value governs.

C-1: printed total 19,640 SF covers PB-1 to PB-4 at the original PB-3 area; with the Addendum revision (+180 SF) in-scope gross is 19,820 SF. PB-5 (640 SF) is outside the printed total (closed, scheduled for demolition, not included).

A-1: printed totals (146.94 mowable ac, 41,630 SF beds, 1,397 trees) include Site 14 (deleted by Addendum No. 1) and the pre-Addendum Site 9 value (6.40 ac, now 7.15); acreage totals could not be declared because declare_tables only accepts sf/sm/sy. Total Site Acres (377.63) are information only and not registered.
A-2: the City states no area for medians/ROW (note 1/, A3); areas were computed as Length × Avg Width × Sides in sq ft. The printed total is length only (30,740 LF; 31,280 LF after the M-6 revision).
Site 9 Creekside Greenway trees are 'not inventoried' (corridor trees maintained by City Forester); no tree count registered.
PB-4 service is seasonal: 7 days/week Apr 1 – Oct 31, Saturday and Sunday only Nov 1 – Mar 31; registered as daily_7.
Table C-2 picnic shelters/gazebo are not custodial buildings (Sec 3.3); registered as paved slab areas (sidewalk kind) serviced with the host site's litter visit.
